BiblicalUsage: Daniel sees the teeth in the night visions: the second beast with three ribs between its teeth, the fourth beast with great iron teeth that devours and breaks in pieces, and the same beast again when the vision is explained.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe teeth in Daniel are the power to devour, and the beasts that bear them are kingdoms that eat nations.
